method: Renders /tmp/r6 (q02-q05, s1-s6, v1-v3) vs omaat_f5/f7/f9/f11/f32/f33/f57/f58/f60, suite_b/omaat_13, jsh_suite-2, tlfl_14. Scale: 43in screen glass = 0.952 m (f11: 608 px -> 1.566 mm/px). Colours sampled with PIL (10-12 px box means); compared as ratios within one image because cabin/studio lighting differ from the photos.

details.refs: omaat_f7, f32, f60. Cap/rib luminance ratio 2.2 (render s6) vs 2.4 (f7), which is fine. The rim above the screen glass is 0.055 m in the model vs 0.036 m in f11 (23 px x 1.566 mm). In q02 the screen-wall cap reads about twice as tall as in f32 (0.07 vs 0.034 m equivalent).

omaat_f7, f58, f60, jsh_suite-2. The real leaf top sits right under the cap (f60: cap bottom y340, leaf top y342; f7 band about 0.06 m). The model has 0.10 m of shell plus a 0.055 m rail above the ribs, so the top band is about 0.15 m vs about 0.06 m. The real slats are broad and flat with narrow dark grooves (about 25 %). The model's 4-segment half-cylinders show a light highlight stripe on each rib, so the field reads as pinstripes (s6 crop). Pulls are protruding silver bars; the real ones are recessed and body-coloured (f7, f60).

omaat_f60. Real: the two ~0.50 m fluted leaves slide out of their parked positions and meet mid-opening, proud of the flank plane. The flanks they uncover are DARK WOOD from the cap to the floor strip. Model: both parked fluted leaves stay in place and two extra 0.32 m leaves are added, so v1 shows four fluted panels plus a fixed fifth, and no wood flanks.

details.detail: Screen wall, window suite (wing, rim, screen)
details.refs: omaat_f11, f7, f58, f60, q03. The wing is 85-105 px of the 608 px screen in f11 (14-17 %, about 0.13-0.16 m) and has a big rounded upper outer corner (r about 0.08). In q03 it is 15 px of 317 (5 %, from wing = 0.05).

omaat_f32 (the q02 viewpoint), f5. In f32 the 2D pier is 205 px against the 2D screen's 235 px, and it carries the lamp, a broad rounded-rect mirror (aspect about 1.8:1) and a safety sticker. In q02 the 2D pier is 30 px against 150 px, with a slot mirror (aspect about 4:1). Code: centre pw = (0.505-0.456)/cos55 = 0.085 m, so mW = min(0.13, pw-0.05) = 0.035 m.

omaat_f11, q03. The pier is 31 % of the screen width in both q03 and f11, which is right. The mirror's #566a78 blue tint only fits f11, where it reflects the screen. In f5 the mirror is #322b24, about the pier wood's luminance (37 vs 43).

details.detail: Console (fascia, black body, grille, wood tray)
details.refs: omaat_f5, f7, f57, tlfl_14. Layout order and the dark lower body are right. The real forward console top is a sculpted dished tray (f5, tlfl_14); the model has a flat tapered wood inlay, acceptable at distance.

omaat_f5, f7, f57, f9, q02, q04. Keypad/console luminance ratio: real 1.0-1.1 (f5 122/111, f57 74/74, f7 115/102); render 1.4 (q04 170/120) to 2.6 (q02 159/62). The keypads read as near-white tiles in q02. The handset aft of the keypad is correct (f7, f57).
omaat_f11, f32, f33. Dark wood top, black lip, PULL tab and box top level with the table all match.
omaat_f11, f7. The cantilevered bench over a dark void, the belt and the rail are right. Tone varies between photos (f11 134 vs f32 50), so no colour penalty.

details.detail: Seat (base, cushion, back seams, leg rest)
details.refs: omaat_f9, suite_b/omaat_13, jsh_suite-2. Proportions are fine. The flap on the 1.10 centre seat is 0.56/0.63 = 89 % of the back vs 76-78 % real (f9, f13).
omaat_f9: 29 % of the back height; model 28 %.

suite_b/omaat_13, f9. The real safety-card door is about 0.54 m tall (f13: y185-435 against the 0.72 back), from about 0.62 to 1.16 m; the model's is 0.42 m. The taupe recessed pull at the wood face's forward edge at armrest height (f13 x95 y440, f9 x945 y660) is missing.

details.detail: Centre divider lowered + board between centre screens
details.refs: omaat_f32, f33, f5, tlfl_14, suite_b/omaat_13. The board height (table to screen top) and its taupe edges match f32/f33. f13 (row 1 from the bulkhead) seems to show two separate splayed boards: see questions.

tlfl_14. Real: an almost uniform dark-wood face, with one taupe vertical member about 0.35 m from the forward end and a thin top edge. The model's two taupe posts and taupe rail are a little too framed.

omaat_f57, f58, f59. The real duvet covers the full bed width over the foot half-to-two-thirds and drapes over the aisle edge (f58). The model duvet is 0.58 x SW = 0.42 m, offset to the window side. In q04 it reads as a narrow white slab on a white pad.

issues.issue: The centre-suite aisle pier is only 0.085 m wide, so its mirror is a 0.035 m slot and the lamp crowds the edge. In q02 the 2D pier nearly vanishes, where f32 shows it as wide as the screen.
issues.evidence: omaat_f32 2D pier 205 px vs screen 235 px; q02 30 px vs 150 px. Code line 73: centre pX0 = 0.456, pw = 0.049/cos55 = 0.085, mW = 0.035.
issues.fix: src/09d_suite.js l.51: for centre put the bezel against the fin: const scx = center ? -hx + 0.014 + 0.488 : xo + wing + 0.488. l.73: pAng = (center ? 70 : 60) * DEG. That gives pX0 = 0.44 and pw = (0.505-0.44)/cos70 = 0.19; mW = min(0.13, pw-0.05) = 0.13 and a 0.44 mirror. The pier reaches z = -L+0.31 at y >= 0.62, above the aisle box (x 0.23..0.51, top 0.64), so there is no clash. Re-check the closing triangle (l.77-78), which follows pX0/pxE automatically.

issues.issue: The closed-door variant is mechanically wrong: the parked fluted leaves stay on the flanks and two extra narrow leaves appear. The real closed state shows two ~0.50 fluted leaves meeting mid-opening, with dark-wood flanks uncovered.
issues.evidence: omaat_f60: left leaf 490 px, right 515 px, meeting at the centre with recessed double pulls. The flanks left (x0-65) and right (x1070-1200) are dark wood from cap to floor strip. v1_doors_aisle.png shows 5 fluted panels.
issues.fix: l.191-205: when doorsShut, drop [-L+0.10,-L+0.60] and [-0.96,-0.46] from the leaf list and use [[zm-0.50, zm], [zm, zm+0.50]] (zm = -1.28) at x = hx+0.010, so they stand ~8 mm proud of the flank plane: shift the gBox/gCyl/frame x by +0.008. Put flank faces in their place: B.add(gRBox(0.006, H-0.20, 0.50, 0.004, 1), M4.trs(hx+0.003, 0.10+(H-0.20)/2, z), SEATMAT.fWood) for z = -L+0.35 and -0.71. Drop the taupe leaf-inner-face box at l.192 or narrow it to 1.00 long. Keep the pulls at zm +/- 0.035, y 0.55.

issues.issue: The aisle leaves sit too low under the cap: a 0.10 shell band plus a 0.055 top rail above the rib field. Real leaves run right up to the cap, with a ~0.03 top rail.
issues.evidence: f60: cap bottom y340, leaf top y342, top rail about 30 px of a 490 px (0.50 m) leaf = 0.03. f7 crop: band about 0.06 of 1.24. s6 crop: a light band about 0.15 m.
issues.fix: l.194-202: yc = 0.10 + (H - 0.12)/2 and leaf height H - 0.12, so it runs 0.10..H-0.02; rib length H - 0.20; stile height H - 0.12; top rail y = H - 0.02 - 0.015 with height 0.03 (not 0.055); bottom rail 0.03 at y 0.115. Keep the 0.055 outer stiles, but make the meeting-edge stile 0.026 wide (f60 25 px).

issues.issue: The keypad panel is far lighter than the console. It reads as white tiles in q02 and q04, where the real keypad is about the console tone with white icons.
issues.evidence: Keypad/console luminance: f5 122/111, f7 115/102, f57 74/74 vs q04 170/120 and q02 159/62.
issues.fix: l.139: keypad panel colour '#8a8882' -> '#6f6a62' (about fConsole x 0.92), r 0.45; keep the '#f2f2f2' glyphs but drop e from 0.1 to 0.05.

issues.issue: The window-side wing of the screen wall is a 0.05 sliver. The real wing is a broad dark-wood panel with a big rounded upper outer corner.
issues.evidence: f11: wing 85-105 px of the 608 px screen (0.13-0.16 m). f58/f60 top-left show the rounded corner, r about 0.08. q03: 15 px of 317 (5 %).
issues.fix: l.50: wing = center ? 0 : 0.10. l.58: gRBox(wing - 0.012, H - 0.68, 0.03, 0.06, 3), so the corner radius goes 0.033 -> 0.06. l.73: keep pX0 = scx + 0.488 = 0.486 and set window pAng 64 deg, giving pw = (0.575-0.486)/cos64 = 0.20 and mW = 0.13. Check the pier stays at about 25-30 % of screen width in the q03 view.

issues.issue: The bed duvet is a narrow 0.42 m slab offset to the window, so white-on-white it barely reads. The real duvet covers the full bed width over the foot half and drapes over the aisle edge.
issues.evidence: omaat_f58: full width, draped on the aisle side, diagonal crease near the head. f57: full width, folded at the foot half. q04: a narrow rectangle plus a triangle.
issues.fix: l.235: dw = SW + 0.03, dx = seatX - 0.01, length 1.30 centred at z = -1.40 (foot end at the ottoman). Colour '#e4e0d8' so it separates from the '#f0efea' pad. Replace the l.241 window-edge strip with an aisle-side drop: gRBox(0.012, 0.10, 1.30, 0.006, 1) at x = dx + dw/2 + 0.004, y = 0.47, z = -1.40. Keep the diagonal turn-down corner, re-anchored at xe = dx + dw/2, z -0.75..-1.03.

issues.issue: The aisle flutes show a light highlight stripe per rib (a 4-segment half-cylinder squashed to 0.6), so the field reads as pinstripes. Real slats are broad and flat, with thin dark grooves.
issues.evidence: omaat_f60 / f7 crops: flat slat faces, groove about 25 %. s6 crop: alternating light/dark stripes of similar weight.
issues.fix: l.200: replace the gCyl rib with gBox(0.005, H - 0.20, 0.020) at x = hx + 0.004 (12 tris, flat face, 0.006 groove at 0.026 pitch), fFlute. If the slat needs an edge, shade it with a darker 0.002 side face rather than a rounded profile.

issues.issue: The screen-wall rim above the glass is too tall (0.055 vs 0.036), which adds to the heavy cap look over the screens in q02.
issues.evidence: f11 rim 23 px x 1.566 mm = 0.036. Model: glass top 1.2475, cap top 1.3025.
issues.fix: l.43: build the front-wall cap only 0.04 tall: B.add(gRBox(w+0.012, 0.04, 0.132, 0.012, 2), M4.trs(0, H + 0.0225, -L + 0.06), SEATMAT.fCap). That gives rim 0.035. Keep the aft/wardrobe caps at 0.06.

issues.issue: The door pulls are protruding silver bars. The real pulls are recessed, body-coloured handles with a dark pocket.
issues.evidence: f7 (x800 y320 of the crop), f60 double recessed pulls at the meeting edge.
issues.fix: l.210: colour -> SEATMAT.fDoorFrame, size 0.010 x 0.08 x 0.022 at hx+0.012, plus a black 0.004 x 0.06 x 0.014 pocket at hx+0.017, y 0.55.

issues.issue: The centre-suite headrest flap is 89 % of the 0.63 back (0.56 fixed), where real is 76-78 %.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9 / suite_b/omaat_13: flap about 0.77 of the back width on both window and centre seats.
issues.fix: l.255-256: flap width 0.56 -> SW * 0.78 (0.56 window, 0.49 centre).

issues.issue: The mirror is always teal-blue. Off-axis it reflects the dark cabin, about the wood's luminance and neutral.
issues.evidence: f5 mirror #322b24 (43) vs pier wood 37; only f11 is blue, from the screen.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.fMirror c '#566a78' -> '#4a545a', m 0.3 -> 0.5, r 0.14 (let the reflection/env term add the blue).

issues.issue: Wardrobe inner face: the safety-card door is too short, and the taupe recessed pull at the forward edge is missing.
issues.evidence: suite_b/omaat_13: door about 0.54 tall (0.62-1.16), pull at armrest height at the forward edge (x95 y440). f9 x945 y660.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: studio/cabin lighting renders shells cream (#c5bdab cap, #948d89 inner walls in q02) where the photos read mid taupe. The sidewall/windows are dominant white in q03 and q05.
issues.evidence: q02 inner wall 142 vs f32 106 luminance.

questions: suite_b/omaat_13 (row 1 centre pair from the bulkhead) seems to show TWO dark-wood boards with taupe edges splaying into a V that opens aft, one per suite, with the lowered divider/consoles visible between them. f32/f33 from the aisle read as one board, and tlfl_14 (divider raised) as an in-plane section. Are the fins hinged panels that splay when the divider is lowered? If the user has a photo from directly above or behind 1D/1G, it would settle whether w5's single in-plane board should become two boards at about +/-12 deg with a gap.

Is the fixed wardrobe run aft of the parked leaf (z -0.46..-0.08) really fluted? In f60 the flank aft of the closed leaf is dark wood, which suggests the parked leaf covers only one leaf width and the remainder is wood. Both f7 and f58 crop the unit at the frame edge.

Real suite widths: the f11/f32 screen-wall composition (0.13 wing + 0.976 bezel + a ~0.30 pier) needs about 1.35 m inside. Is 1.24 m for the window suite sourced, or could it grow within the aisle rule?
